 Sajid Raza Published: Oct 26, 2026, 11:48 IST Updated: Oct 26, 2026, 11:48 IST School Holiday Today Schools in several parts of India are observing a holiday on Monday, October 26, 2026, on the occasion of Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti . Students and parents are checking whether schools will remain closed today or continue with their regular classes.
 The school holiday on October 26 is based on the state Government's notification of the school holiday and the academic schedule for each institution. Schools in some states are cancelled but in others they will be open.
 No school holiday has been confirmed for October 26, 2026, in states including Andhra Pradesh, Assam, Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Goa, Gujarat, Jharkhand, Karnataka, Kerala, Maharashtra, Odisha, Rajasthan, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Uttarakhand and West Bengal.

 According to available holiday calendars and news reports, the following regions have a holiday listed for October 26, 2026.

 The Uttar Pradesh government has declared a public holiday on October 26 for Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti. Schools covered by the applicable government order are expected to remain closed.
 The above list is indicative and should not be treated as a confirmation for every school. Holiday rules and institutional calendars may vary.
 Are schools open today in Delhi-NCR? 
 Students in Delhi-NCR, including Noida, Ghaziabad, Gurugram and Faridabad, should check their respective school announcements before making plans.
 October 26 is a holiday in Delhi, but this doesn't mean that all private schools or institutions around the NCR are closed. There may be different orders and school calendar applicable in Noida, Ghaziabad, Gurugram and Faridabad.
 Parents should check official school messages, notices or circulars for the latest holiday update.
 Why is Valmiki Jayanti celebrated? 
 Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti is observed to mark the birth anniversary of Maharishi Valmiki, who is traditionally credited with composing the Hindu epic Ramayana . He is also known as Adi Kavi, meaning the first poet in Sanskrit literature.
 The occasion is celebrated in several parts of India through prayers, religious gatherings, cultural programmes and other events. Many states and Union Territories observe the day as a public holiday.
 However, the school holiday status for October 26, 2026, may vary by state and institution. Students and parents should check the relevant government notification or school circular to confirm whether classes will remain suspended.
 Tamil Nadu rain today: Heavy rain forces school closures in several districts
 Heavy rainfall has prompted authorities to declare school holidays in several parts of Tamil Nadu on Monday, October 26, 2026. District administrations have announced closures as a precautionary measure amid waterlogging, continued rain and weather warnings. 
 However, the holiday is not applicable across the entire state.
 According to reports, schools in Coimbatore, Dindigul and Ramanathapuram have been declared closed for the day. In the Nilgiris district, the holiday applies to schools in selected taluks, including Ooty, Coonoor, Kotagiri and Kundah. Some schools in Kallakurichi district have also been given a holiday.
 The holiday decisions are district-specific and may change depending on rainfall and local conditions. Parents should follow official announcements for confirmation of school closures, examinations and any changes to class schedules.
